about: Introduction-order pins read by scripts/enrich/freq.py: the word is ordered as if its frequency were order_f; its shipped f stays the measured value. docs/plan/08 §2.4, §7.2.

w4db.why: 2026-11-14: headword corrected 副 → とりわけ (source error, docs/plan/12 §6). f is now とりわけ's own (42, was 副's 46); the word keeps the place it had since the order was made (154 of N1) so that no other N1 word's position moves for learners who have started.

w3nu.why: 2026-11-14: reading corrected ふす → むす (source error, docs/plan/12 §6, source-errors.csv). f is now 蒸す むす's own (34, was 27 measured for the wrong pair); the word keeps its place (1801 of N2) so that no other N2 word's position moves for learners who have started.

w4ta.why: 2026-11-14: headword corrected 摩する → 摩る (source error, docs/plan/12 §6, source-errors.csv). f is now 摩る さする's own (32, was the floor 10: 摩する was not found); the word keeps its place (2698 of N1, last) so that no other N1 word's position moves for learners who have started.
